meta.title: Florentin Tchangai — Technology Architect
meta.description: Florentin Tchangai designs, builds, and evolves digital systems from Lomé, Togo. Bilingual portfolio of a technology architect and consultant.

home.subtitle: Software architect & full-stack engineer. I help organizations and startups build resilient platforms, enterprise-grade banking architectures, and intelligent workflows.
home.worksSubtitle: A curated selection of robust platforms, open-source tools, and scalable systems.
home.servicesSubtitle: From database foundations to front-of-the-screen craft, I deliver across every mission-critical layer.
home.s1Desc: Designing mission-critical backends, domain modeling (DDD), and seamless integrations into central banking infrastructure.
home.s1Focus: High availability, optimized SQL procedures, strict security & banking auditability.
home.s2Desc: Craft-level frontend and full-stack engineering. Responsive systems, disciplined design foundations, and measurable performance.
home.s2Focus: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, WCAG AA, keyboard-first interactions.
home.s3Desc: Architecting relational database schemas, query optimization under heavy load, and business intelligence dashboards.
home.s3Focus: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Redis, OLTP/OLAP modeling, Power BI reporting.
home.s4Desc: Building developer-first command-line tools for the open-source ecosystem, CI/CD pipelines, and intelligent automations.
home.s4Focus: Node.js CLI, npm packages, automated workflows, OpenCV/TensorFlow integration.
home.stackSubtitle: Battle-tested technologies selected for long-term resilience, maintainability, and operational velocity.
home.stackLayer1Items: Next.js (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Radix UI, Framer Motion
home.stackLayer2Items: Node.js, Express, Python, .NET Core / C#, REST & GraphQL APIs
home.stackLayer3Items: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Redis (Caching), Prisma ORM, Sanity CMS
home.stackLayer4Items: Docker, Linux, GitHub Actions, Vercel, npm, OpenCV / TensorFlow
home.philosophySubtitle: Building systems that outlast trends requires mental discipline, sound theory, and continuous study.
home.p1Desc: Unnecessary complexity is the root of technical debt. The best architectures are transparent, predictable, and easy to maintain.
home.p2Desc: Every network boundary, remote dependency, and database will eventually fail. Resilient systems plan for graceful degradation.
home.p3Desc: From foreign key constraints down to keyboard navigation and focus rings, quality is the sum of countless disciplined details.
home.contactSubtitle: Whether you need a resilient banking architecture, a high-performance web platform, or advisory, let's talk.

about.title: Software architect, systems builder & web craftsman.
about.subtitle: System architect based in Lomé, Togo. Committed to simplicity, disciplined data modeling, and code longevity.
about.bioP1: Holding a Master's degree in Software Architecture from ESGIS, I have spent the last 4+ years designing and scaling mission-critical platforms.
about.bioP2: At Ecobank Transnational Incorporated, I contributed to the architecture and optimization of SmartLoan, a digital lending engine that processed over $50M in loan applications under strict fault tolerance requirements.
about.bioP3: My engineering approach values conceptual clarity over cleverness: resilient relational schemas, predictable APIs, and frontends built with uncompromising craft.
